title: [Minor Visual Bug] Automation Location - Lat & Long not correctly displayed
symptom: When configuring an automation based on location, the field is not wide enough to display the number with the default 6 decimal places, causing the first 1-2 digits of the integer value to be obscured behind the [-] sign and the last 1-2 digits of the decimal value to be obscured behind the [+] sign.
fix: A commit was referenced that likely fixes the issue, but the thread does not describe the specific changes.
